title: A Forest Without Barriers
description: Carry the Twilight Forest's native chain through its final available progression milestones: Troll territory, the merged progression threshold, trophy-pedestal access, and the native progression end. This closes REIGN's wrapper without inventing a conclusion the Forest itself does not provide.
description_completed: The Twilight Forest's implemented progression has been carried to its native end state under the Overlord's reign.

objectives.name: Reach the Forest's native progression end
